tagline.en: ₹5 lakh to build your own house
tagline.hi: अपना घर बनाने के लिए ₹5 लाख

source.quote: The family must reside in Telangana and hold a white ration card.
The family must reside in Telangana and hold a white ration card.
The family must not own a pucca house anywhere.

summary.en: ₹5,00,000 in stages as the house is built

source.quote: Financial assistance of ₹5,00,000 is given to build a house, released in stages as construction progresses.

summary.en: Apply via Praja Palana or the Indiramma Indlu survey; lists are approved in the Gram / Ward Sabha.
summary.hi: प्रजा पालना या इंदिरम्मा इंडलू सर्वे से आवेदन; सूची ग्राम / वार्ड सभा में मंज़ूर होती है।
summary.te: ప్రజా పాలన లేదా ఇందిరమ్మ ఇళ్ల సర్వే ద్వారా దరఖాస్తు; జాబితాను గ్రామ / వార్డు సభ ఆమోదిస్తుంది.

source.quote: Apply through the Praja Palana application or the Indiramma Indlu app survey conducted in your village or ward.
